text:
Maya: Heads up — we need a board-ready runbook and demo cue cards for Northstar ahead of the exec readout next Thursday. Can folks confirm owners?
Ethan: I can own the runbook draft. Will pull the latest success metrics and renewal runway.
Priya: I'll do demo cue cards + 2 minute customer story clip. Need the final slide order from you, @Maya.
Jordan: I can help with slide polish and create a 'what-if' fallback slide for the capacity/latency ask.
Sam: I'll lock the ask numbers (ARR impact, renewal timeline) and run them by finance for confirmation by Tue.
enablement-bot: Reminder: templates available at https://redwood.in/enablement-templates — use `board-readout_v2.pptx`.
Maya: Rough agenda I'm aiming for (short):
```
- 2m: Exec context + renewal status
- 5m: Health metrics and demo
- 3m: Risks & mitigation
- 2m: Ask & next steps
```
Maya: Priorities: make the demo tiny (30-45s main flow), call out an outage mitigation story, and surface the trial->paid conversion delta.
Ethan: For the runbook I'll include a one-page risk matrix: probability / impact / owner. Quick draft by Monday EOD.
Priya: Demo clip needs a scripted line for the AE to narrate — @Jordan can you script + timecheck?
Jordan: Yep — will post script in this thread and a 30s run-through recording by Tue morning.
Sam: Finance check: confirmed ARR ask numbers are conservative — I'll attach a short note.
Maya: Action items recap:
- Ethan: Runbook draft (Mon EOD)
- Priya: Demo cue cards + clip (Tue)
- Jordan: Script + 30s recording (Tue AM)
- Sam: Finance note + ARR validation (Tue EOD)
- Maya: Final slide order & rehearsal schedule (Wed)
Ethan: Any specific KPIs I should pull? churn cohorts?
Maya: Focus on net retention, onboarding time for top 10 seats, and error-rate impact on adoption. Keep visuals simple.
Priya: Also add 1 customer quote slide (short) — @Sam can you confirm which customer we can spotlight?
Sam: Recommend Meridian — legal already signed the quote to be used. I'll attach the approved snippet.
Jordan: Small ask — can we include a single line about scaling plan (Dedicated -> Private path) so execs see options?
Maya: Good call. Keep it one line under 'Mitigation' with a pointer to the Dedicated capacity playbook.
enablement-bot: New file created: /templates/board-readout_v2.pptx by Priya at 1718234701
Ethan: Draft uploaded to the drive: drive.redwood/in/nb_runbook_v1 — feedback welcome.
Maya: Let's do a dry-run Wed 10:00 PT. Reply with :thumbsup: if that works.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Ethan: :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks team — I'll stitch these into a rehearsal script and ping calendar invites. If anything slips, flag here so we can reassign.
Jordan: Noted — will post script link shortly.
Priya: Uploading clip now.
Sam: Finance note attached.
Maya: Last call — any blockers?
Ethan: None from me.
Priya: All good.
Jordan: No blockers.
Sam: All set.
Maya: Great — closing thread for now, will reopen after rehearsal with any follow-ups.
